name: sup_op
description: Join (supremum) of two elements in a lattice
lean_statement: def sup_op {α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup α] (a b : α) : α := a ⊔ b

name: inf_op
description: Meet (infimum) of two elements in a lattice
lean_statement: def inf_op {α : Type*} [SemilatticeInf α] (a b : α) : α := a ⊓ b

name: top_op
description: Top element of a bounded order
lean_statement: def top_op (α : Type*) [OrderTop α] : α := ⊤

name: bot_op
description: Bottom element of a bounded order
lean_statement: def bot_op (α : Type*) [OrderBot α] : α := ⊥

name: monotone_def
description: A function is monotone if it preserves the order: a ≤ b implies f a ≤ f b
lean_statement:
-- Monotone function: preserves order
-- In Mathlib: Monotone f
example {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (f : α → β) (hf : Monotone f) (a b : α) (h : a ≤ b) : f a ≤ f b := hf h

name: antitone_def
description: A function is antitone (order-reversing) if a ≤ b implies f b ≤ f a
lean_statement:
-- Antitone function: reverses order
-- In Mathlib: Antitone f
example {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (f : α → β) (hf : Antitone f) (a b : α) (h : a ≤ b) : f b ≤ f a := hf h

name: galois_connection_def
description: A Galois connection between preorders: a pair (l, u) where l a ≤ b iff a ≤ u b. The lower adjoint l and upper adjoint u form an adjunction.
lean_statement:
-- Galois connection: l ⊣ u means ∀ a b, l a ≤ b ↔ a ≤ u b
-- In Mathlib: GaloisConnection l u
example {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) (a : α) (b : β) : l a ≤ b ↔ a ≤ u b := gc.le_iff_le a b

name: galois_insertion_def
description: A Galois insertion is a Galois connection where the upper adjoint is injective (equivalently, l ∘ u = id). Stronger than a Galois connection.
lean_statement:
-- Galois insertion: a Galois connection where u is a section of l
-- In Mathlib: GaloisInsertion l u
example {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gi : GaloisInsertion l u) : GaloisConnection l u := gi.gc

name: closure_operator_def
description: A closure operator is a monotone, extensive (a ≤ cl a), idempotent (cl (cl a) = cl a) function. The composition u ∘ l of a Galois connection is a closure operator.
lean_statement:
-- Closure operator: monotone, extensive, idempotent
-- In Mathlib: ClosureOperator α
example {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] (cl : ClosureOperator α) (a : α) : a ≤ cl a := cl.le_closure a

name: fixed_point_def
description: A fixed point of a function f is an element x such that f x = x
lean_statement: def is_fixed_point {α : Type*} (f : α → α) (x : α) : Prop := f x = x

name: lfp_def
description: Least fixed point of a monotone function on a complete lattice (Knaster-Tarski)
lean_statement:
-- Least fixed point via Knaster-Tarski
-- In Mathlib: OrderHom.lfp
example {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] (f : α →o α) : f (OrderHom.lfp f) = OrderHom.lfp f := OrderHom.lfp_eq f

name: gfp_def
description: Greatest fixed point of a monotone function on a complete lattice (Knaster-Tarski)
lean_statement:
-- Greatest fixed point via Knaster-Tarski
-- In Mathlib: OrderHom.gfp
example {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] (f : α →o α) : f (OrderHom.gfp f) = OrderHom.gfp f := OrderHom.gfp_eq f

name: le_sup_left
description: An element is less than or equal to its join with another: a ≤ a ⊔ b
lean_statement: theorem le_sup_left_order {α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup α] (a b : α) : a ≤ a ⊔ b

name: inf_le_left
description: The meet of two elements is less than or equal to each: a ⊓ b ≤ a
lean_statement: theorem inf_le_left_order {α : Type*} [SemilatticeInf α] (a b : α) : a ⊓ b ≤ a

name: sup_comm
description: Join is commutative: a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a
lean_statement: theorem sup_comm_order {α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup α] (a b : α) : a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a

name: inf_comm
description: Meet is commutative: a ⊓ b = b ⊓ a
lean_statement: theorem inf_comm_order {α : Type*} [SemilatticeInf α] (a b : α) : a ⊓ b = b ⊓ a

name: sup_inf_distrib
description: In a distributive lattice, join distributes over meet: a ⊔ (b ⊓ c) = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (a ⊔ c)
lean_statement: theorem sup_inf_distrib_order {α : Type*} [DistribLattice α] (a b c : α) : a ⊔ (b ⊓ c) = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (a ⊔ c)

name: gc_unit
description: Unit of a Galois connection: a ≤ u (l a). The upper adjoint applied after the lower adjoint is extensive.
lean_statement: theorem gc_unit {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) (a : α) : a ≤ u (l a)

name: gc_counit
description: Counit of a Galois connection: l (u b) ≤ b. The lower adjoint applied after the upper adjoint is reductive.
lean_statement: theorem gc_counit {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) (b : β) : l (u b) ≤ b

name: gc_monotone_l
description: The lower adjoint of a Galois connection is monotone
lean_statement: theorem gc_monotone_l {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) : Monotone l

name: gc_monotone_u
description: The upper adjoint of a Galois connection is monotone
lean_statement: theorem gc_monotone_u {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) : Monotone u

name: gc_compose_extensive
description: The round-trip u ∘ l is extensive: a ≤ (u ∘ l) a. This is the closure property.
lean_statement: theorem gc_compose_extensive {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) (a : α) : a ≤ u (l a)

name: gc_compose_idempotent
description: The round-trip u ∘ l ∘ u ∘ l = u ∘ l: the closure is idempotent
lean_statement: theorem gc_compose_idempotent {α β : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [Preorder β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) (a : α) : u (l (u (l a))) = u (l a)

name: le_top
description: Every element is less than or equal to top
lean_statement: theorem le_top_order {α : Type*} [OrderTop α] (a : α) : a ≤ ⊤

name: bot_le
description: Bottom is less than or equal to every element
lean_statement: theorem bot_le_order {α : Type*} [OrderBot α] (a : α) : ⊥ ≤ a
